summary: First full-stack test of Synqora landing page. Backend: 6/6 pytest cases passed for POST/GET /api/demo-requests including invalid email (422), missing required fields (422), persistence via GET after POST. Frontend: All 12 sections load, all data-testid selectors present, demo modal opens from navbar/hero, tour modal opens from hero and correctly transitions to demo modal via tour-book-demo-button, empty form submit does not show success (validation working), valid form submit shows demo-success state, all 6 platform-module buttons switch content, all 5 role tabs switch dashboard, all 5 FAQ items expand/collapse.

issues: Sticky navbar overlaps the top of section titles when scrolled (e.g., 'Trusted by leaders building the next category.' is partially hidden behind the nav). Consider adding scroll-margin-top on anchor sections or top padding.

Recharts warns 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' repeatedly — charts inside conditionally-rendered/hidden containers do not have a min height. Not visually broken but pollutes console; wrap ResponsiveContainer with fixed minHeight or aspect ratio.
Radix Dialog warning: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby for DialogContent'. Add <DialogDescription> for a11y.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Add scroll-margin-top to sections to fix sticky-nav overlap on anchor scroll.
(Optional/minor) Fix Recharts container sizing to remove width/height(-1) warnings.
(Optional/a11y) Add DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to Demo and Tour dialogs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: uses @app.on_event('shutdown') which is deprecated in FastAPI; prefer lifespan context. Non-blocking.
server.py properly excludes MongoDB _id via projection {"_id": 0} — good.
server.py uses EmailStr and Pydantic validation for demo requests — correct 422 behavior verified.
No auth on GET /api/demo-requests — acceptable for MVP but data is publicly listable; flag for future.
seed_data_creation: Created a few TEST_ prefixed demo requests in demo_requests collection via tests and UI (test_ui@example.com, test_alice@example.com, test_bob@example.com).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Landing page + backend fully working. Only minor cosmetic/a11y issues remain. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_synqora_api.py. Public URL from frontend/.env; all endpoints under /api prefix.
